title: Love, love, love this!!
text: Love, love, love this!!. This product is sooooo cute. The product is a thin, light weight metal that is made well and has no rough edges. The back has a keyhole slot for your hanging device. The colors are painted excellently and the distressing is done in a tasteful way to make it look like an old sign. The size is perfect for an open wall or above stove like mine. Very happy with purchase.

product_metadata.title: Creative Co-Op Tin "Eat Here" Retro Wall Decor
features: Vintage design with heavily distressed finish
Yellow painted bulb design gives the illusion of an electric sign
description: Delight your family members and put a smile on guests’ faces with this wonderfully retro wall decor. Inspired by classic 50s Americana and old diners that used to dot the sides of Highways the country over, this charming design showcases a swooping red Arrow fitted with yellow faux-lightbulbs around a teal sign displaying the words: “Eat here. ” made from tin and distressed for a vintage, antiqued look, this piece showcases a keyhole hanger for easy installation. To establish a farmhouse chic aesthetic in your open concept, eat-in kitchen, mount this sign over a slatted wooded banquette by a brightly-lit window in the corner. Set the table with a galvanized steel Pail full of freshly-cut Calla lilies as a floral centerpiece for any occasion, then install a repurposed mason jar pendant light overhead to wash the room in a quaint country glow.
